# SensibleJS — Complete LLM Reference

> Reactive UI in ~5KB gzipped. No build step. No virtual DOM. No dependencies. Just HTML attributes.
> Source: sensibljs.js | NPM: sensibljs | CDN: use sensibljs.min.js

---

## Getting Started

### Minimal Example

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <script src="sensibljs.min.js" defer></script>
</head>
<body>
    <input type="text" s-bind="name" placeholder="Your name">
    <p s-bind="name">Hello, {name}!</p>

    <script>
    let store = {
        data: {
            name: { type: String, default: '' }
        }
    };
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

**Key facts:**
- The `<script>` tag with `defer` loads the library
- `let store = { ... }` must be a global variable named `store`
- SensibleJS detects `window.store` automatically and initializes — no function call needed
- All store variables become window globals (`name`, `count`, etc.)

### Include Methods

```html
<!-- Direct / CDN -->
<script src="sensibljs.min.js" defer></script>

<!-- NPM -->
npm i sensibljs
```

---

## Store Configuration

```js
let store = {
    persist: true,          // Enable localStorage persistence (default: true)
    localPrefix: '__',      // Prefix for localStorage keys (default: '__')
    data: {
        // Variable definitions go here
    },
    onInit: function(data) {
        // Called after SensibleJS finishes initializing
        // `data` is the reactive data object (_data)
        console.log('Ready!');
    }
};
```

### Store Options

| Option        | Type     | Default | Description |
|---------------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `persist`     | Boolean  | `true`  | Save/restore variables to localStorage |
| `localPrefix` | String   | `'__'`  | Prefix for all localStorage keys |
| `data`        | Object   | `{}`    | Variable definitions |
| `onInit`      | Function | —       | Lifecycle hook, receives `_data` object |

---

## Variable Types & Options

### Declaring Variables

```js
data: {
    username: { type: String,  default: 'guest' },
    count:    { type: Number,  default: 0 },
    active:   { type: Boolean, default: true },
    items:    { type: Array,   default: [{ id: 1, text: 'First' }] },
    config:   { type: Object,  default: { theme: 'dark', lang: 'en' } },
    total:    { computed: 'price * quantity' },
    query:    { type: String, default: '', persist: false },
    search:   {
        type: String,
        default: '',
        watch: function(newVal, oldVal) {
            console.log('Changed:', oldVal, '->', newVal);
        }
    }
}
```

### Variable Options Reference

| Option     | Type                          | Description |
|------------|-------------------------------|-------------|
| `type`     | `String/Number/Boolean/Array/Object` | JavaScript type constructor |
| `default`  | any                           | Initial value |
| `persist`  | Boolean                       | Override store-level persist for this variable |
| `computed` | String                        | Expression string; makes variable read-only |
| `watch`    | Function(newVal, oldVal)      | Callback on every change |

### Type Behaviors

**String/Number/Boolean:** Single `Observer` wrapping the value. Setting the variable triggers all bound elements to update.

**Array:** Uses `ArrayObserver`. Observed mutation methods: `push`, `pop`, `splice`, `reverse`, `shift`, `sort`, `unshift`, `concat`. Direct index assignment (`arr[0] = x`) is NOT observed.

**Object:** Each property in the default object gets its own `Observer`. Setting `obj.prop = x` is reactive. Adding new properties after init is NOT observed.

**Computed:** Read-only getter. Re-evaluates when any referenced variable changes. Cannot be assigned to.

---

## Directives Reference

### `s-bind` — Two-Way Data Binding

Connects an element to a variable. Works with all standard input types and display elements.

```html
<!-- Text input: updates on keyup -->
<input type="text" s-bind="name">

<!-- Update only on blur -->
<input type="text" s-bind="name" s-blur>

<!-- Debounced: wait 300ms after typing stops -->
<input type="text" s-bind="search" s-debounce="300">

<!-- Display with template expression -->
<p s-bind="name">Hello, {name}!</p>
<p s-bind="count">{count} items in cart</p>

<!-- Checkbox: boolean binding -->
<input type="checkbox" s-bind="darkMode">

<!-- Radio: value binding -->
<input type="radio" s-bind="size" value="sm" name="size"> Small
<input type="radio" s-bind="size" value="lg" name="size"> Large

<!-- Select -->
<select s-bind="priority">
    <option value="low">Low</option>
    <option value="med">Medium</option>
    <option value="high">High</option>
</select>

<!-- Number / Range -->
<input type="number" s-bind="quantity">
<input type="range" s-bind="volume" min="0" max="100">

<!-- Color / Date -->
<input type="color" s-bind="accent">
<input type="date" s-bind="deadline">

<!-- Image: sets src attribute -->
<img s-bind="avatarUrl">

<!-- Contenteditable -->
<div contenteditable="true" s-bind="notes"></div>
```

### Supported Input Types

| Input Type             | Event    | Notes |
|------------------------|----------|-------|
| `text`, `email`        | `keyup`  | Or `blur` with `s-blur` attribute |
| `textarea`             | `keyup`  | Or `blur` with `s-blur` attribute |
| `checkbox`             | `change` | Boolean binding |
| `radio`                | `change` | Binds to selected value |
| `select`               | `change` | Binds to option value |
| `number`, `range`      | `input`  | Continuous updates |
| `color`                | `input`  | Continuous updates |
| `date`, `datetime-local` | `input` | |
| `img`                  | —        | Sets `src` attribute |
| `contenteditable`      | `input`  | Binds `innerText` |

### `s-if` — Conditional Rendering

Shows or hides elements. Preserves the element's original `display` value (flex, grid, inline, etc.).

```html
<div s-if="isLoggedIn">Welcome back!</div>
<div s-if="!isLoggedIn">Please log in.</div>
<div s-if="items.length > 0">You have {items.length} items.</div>
<div s-if="name !== ''">Hello, {name}</div>

<!-- With transition animation -->
<div s-if="showPanel" s-transition="fade">Animated panel</div>
```

### `s-for` — List Rendering

Iterates over arrays with keyed reconciliation.

```html
<div s-for="item of items" s-key="item.id">
    {item.name} - ${item.price}
</div>

<!-- Access the loop index (0-based) -->
<div s-for="user of users" s-key="user.id">
    {index + 1}. {user.name}
</div>

<!-- Images in loops use s-src -->
<div s-for="photo of photos" s-key="photo.id">
    <img s-src="{photo.url}">
</div>
```

See [s-for In Depth](#s-for-in-depth) for complete coverage.

### `s-text` — Safe Text Content

Sets `textContent` from an expression. HTML is escaped.

```html
<p s-text="username"></p>
<span s-text="'Hello, ' + name"></span>
<span s-text="items.length + ' items'"></span>
<span s-text="score >= 90 ? 'Excellent' : 'Good'"></span>
```

### `s-html` — Raw HTML Content

Sets `innerHTML`. **Only use with trusted content.**

```html
<div s-html="richContent"></div>
<div s-html="'<strong>' + title + '</strong>'"></div>
```

### `s-class` — Conditional CSS Classes

Semicolon-separated `className: expression` pairs.

```html
<div s-class="active: isActive">Toggle active class</div>
<div s-class="active: isActive; error: hasError; hidden: !isVisible">Multiple</div>
<input s-class="valid-border: email.indexOf('@') > 0; invalid-border: email.indexOf('@') < 0">
```

### `s-css` — Dynamic Inline Styles

Semicolon-separated `property: expression` pairs. Supports template `{expressions}`.

```html
<div s-css="background-color: bgColor">Simple variable</div>
<div s-css="background-color: {accentColor}; color: {textColor}">Template syntax</div>
<div s-css="width: {percent + '%'}; opacity: {opacity / 100}">Expressions</div>
<div s-css="background-color: {score >= 50 ? 'green' : 'red'}">Ternary</div>
```

### `s-attr` — Dynamic HTML Attributes

Semicolon-separated `attribute: expression` pairs.

```html
<button s-attr="disabled: !formValid">Submit</button>
<a s-attr="href: linkUrl; target: openNew ? '_blank' : '_self'">Link</a>
<div s-attr="aria-hidden: !isVisible; aria-expanded: isOpen">Panel</div>
<input s-attr="placeholder: 'Search ' + category + '...'">
```

**Value behavior:**
- `false` / `null` / `undefined` → attribute removed
- `true` → empty attribute (e.g., `disabled`)
- Any other value → attribute set to that value

**Security:** `on*` attributes (onclick, onerror, etc.) are blocked.

### `s-click` — Click Handler

```html
<button s-click="count++">Increment</button>
<button s-click="count = 0">Reset</button>
<button s-click="items.push({id: Date.now(), text: 'New'})">Add</button>
```

### `s-unclick` — Click Outside Handler

Fires when a click occurs outside the element.

```html
<div s-unclick="menuOpen = false">
    <button s-click="menuOpen = !menuOpen">Toggle Menu</button>
    <div s-if="menuOpen">Menu content...</div>
</div>
```

### `s-on` — General Event Binding

Format: `event.modifier: expression`. Multiple bindings separated by semicolons.

```html
<input s-on="keydown.enter: submitForm()">
<div s-on="keydown.escape: closeModal()">
<form s-on="submit.prevent: handleSubmit()">
<div s-on="mouseenter: hover = true; mouseleave: hover = false">
```

**Modifiers:**

| Modifier   | Effect |
|------------|--------|
| `.prevent` | `event.preventDefault()` |
| `.stop`    | `event.stopPropagation()` |
| `.enter`   | Only fires on Enter key |
| `.escape`  | Only fires on Escape key |

### `s-ref` — Element References

```html
<input type="text" s-ref="myInput">
<button s-click="$refs.myInput.focus()">Focus Input</button>
<button s-click="$refs.myInput.value = ''">Clear</button>
```

### `s-cloak` — Hide Until Ready

Prevents flash of unprocessed template expressions. Removed automatically after init.

```html
<body s-cloak>
    <p s-bind="name">Hello, {name}!</p>
</body>
```

SensibleJS auto-injects `[s-cloak] { display: none !important }`.

### `s-data` — Inline Variable Definition

Define variables directly in HTML without adding to the store.

```html
<div s-data="{count: 0, message: 'Hello'}">
    <button s-click="count++">Count: <span s-bind="count">{count}</span></button>
    <p s-bind="message">{message}</p>
</div>
```

### `s-debounce` — Debounced Input

Delay updates on text inputs until typing stops. Value in milliseconds.

```html
<input s-bind="search" s-debounce="300">
<textarea s-bind="notes" s-debounce="500"></textarea>
```

### `s-blur` — Update on Blur

Switch from keyup to blur for text input binding.

```html
<input s-bind="tagline" s-blur>
```

### `s-transition` — CSS Animations

Animate `s-if` show/hide and `s-for` enter/leave.

```html
<div s-if="show" s-transition="fade">Animated content</div>
<div s-for="item of items" s-key="item.id" s-transition="slide">Animated list</div>
```

**CSS class lifecycle:**
- **Enter:** `{name}-enter` → `{name}-enter-active` + `{name}-enter-to` → cleanup
- **Leave:** `{name}-leave` → `{name}-leave-active` + `{name}-leave-to` → `display: none`

```css
/* Fade transition */
.fade-enter, .fade-leave-to      { opacity: 0; }
.fade-enter-active,
.fade-leave-active                { transition: opacity 0.3s ease; }
.fade-enter-to                    { opacity: 1; }

/* Slide transition */
.slide-enter     { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-10px); }
.slide-enter-to  { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
.slide-leave-to  { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(20px); }
.slide-enter-active,
.slide-leave-active { transition: opacity 0.3s, transform 0.3s; }
```

If `s-transition` has no value (`<div s-transition>`), prefix defaults to `s-`.

### `s-src` — Dynamic Image Source

For images inside `s-for` loops. Uses template syntax.

```html
<div s-for="photo of photos" s-key="photo.id">
    <img s-src="{photo.url}" alt="{photo.caption}">
</div>
```

### `s-key` — List Item Key

Tells `s-for` how to identify each item for efficient DOM reconciliation.

```html
<div s-for="item of items" s-key="item.id">...</div>
```

Without `s-key`, numeric index is used (less efficient for reordering).

---

## s-for In Depth

### Basic Usage

```html
<div s-for="item of items" s-key="item.id">
    {item.name}
</div>
```

### Available Variables in Loop Scope

- **The loop variable** (e.g., `item`, `t`, `user`) — the current array element
- **`index`** — 0-based numeric index of the current iteration

### Template Expressions in Loops

Use `{expression}` syntax for inline values:

```html
<div s-for="item of items" s-key="item.id">
    <span>{index + 1}. {item.name}</span>
    <span>${item.price.toFixed(2)}</span>
</div>
```

### Directives Inside s-for

All standard directives work inside s-for with access to the loop variable:

```html
<div s-for="task of tasks" s-key="task.id">
    <!-- s-text: safe text content -->
    <span s-text="task.title"></span>

    <!-- s-html: raw HTML (trusted content only) -->
    <div s-html="task.description"></div>

    <!-- s-if: conditional rendering -->
    <span s-if="task.done">Completed</span>
    <span s-if="!task.done">Pending</span>

    <!-- s-class: conditional classes -->
    <span s-class="done: task.done; urgent: task.priority === 'high'"></span>

    <!-- s-attr: dynamic attributes -->
    <input type="checkbox" s-attr="checked: task.done">
    <span s-attr="data-priority: task.priority"></span>

    <!-- s-css: dynamic styles -->
    <div s-css="color: {task.done ? '#999' : '#000'}; opacity: {task.done ? 0.6 : 1}"></div>

    <!-- s-src: dynamic image source -->
    <img s-src="{task.imageUrl}">
</div>
```

Single quotes work in directive attribute values inside s-for templates (e.g., `s-if="t.due !== ''"`).

### s-if Wrapper Around s-for (Empty State Pattern)

Wrap `s-for` in an `s-if` to conditionally show the list and provide an alternate empty state:

```html
<!-- Show list only when there are visible items -->
<div s-if="visibleItems.length > 0">
    <div s-for="item of visibleItems" s-key="item.id" s-transition="slide">
        <span s-text="item.name"></span>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- Contextual empty states -->
<div s-if="items.length === 0">
    No items yet — add one above.
</div>
<div s-if="items.length > 0 && visibleItems.length === 0 && query.length > 0">
    Nothing matches "<span s-text="query"></span>".
</div>
<div s-if="items.length > 0 && visibleItems.length === 0 && filter === 'done'">
    Nothing completed yet.
</div>
```

This is the recommended pattern. The `s-if` wrapper and `s-for` work correctly together.

### Event Handling in s-for

`s-click` and `s-on` work inside s-for with full access to the loop variable and `index`. Store variables remain reactive — array mutations trigger re-renders.

```html
<div s-for="t of tasks" s-key="t.id">
    <input type="checkbox" s-attr="checked: t.done"
           s-click="tasks.updateWhere('id', t.id, {done: !t.done})">
    <span s-text="t.title"></span>
    <button s-click="tasks.removeWhere('id', t.id)">Remove</button>
</div>
```

No helper functions needed — the loop variable (`t`) and array helpers (`updateWhere`, `removeWhere`) handle everything inline.

### $find Helper (for onclick outside s-for)

For `onclick` handlers that are NOT inside s-for scope, use the `$find(array, el)` global helper:

```js
function toggle(el) {
    var match = $find(tasks, el);  // returns {item, index} or null
    if (match) tasks.update(match.index, { done: !match.item.done });
}
```

`$find` reads the `s-key-value` and `s-key-prop` attributes from the closest keyed ancestor.

### Select Binding in s-for

```html
<div s-for="t of tasks" s-key="t.id">
    <select onchange="updatePriority(this)">
        <option value="low">Low</option>
        <option value="med">Medium</option>
        <option value="high">High</option>
    </select>
</div>

<script>
function updatePriority(el) {
    var i = findIndexByKey(tasks, el);
    if (i === -1) return;
    tasks.splice(i, 1, Object.assign({}, tasks[i], { priority: el.value }));
}
</script>
```

### Dynamic Option Values in s-for

Option elements can have dynamic values:

```html
<div s-for="opt of options" s-key="opt.id">
    <option value="{opt.value}">{opt.label}</option>
</div>
```

### Animated s-for

```html
<div s-for="item of items" s-key="item.id" s-transition="task">
    <div class="task-row">{item.text}</div>
</div>
```

```css
.task-enter { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); }
.task-enter-active { transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.2s; }
.task-enter-to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
.task-leave-active { transition: opacity 0.2s, max-height 0.2s; overflow: hidden; }
.task-leave-to { opacity: 0; }
```

---

## Reactivity Model

### How Updates Work

1. Setting a variable (`count = 5`) triggers the Observer setter
2. All registered observers are notified
3. `scheduleUpdate(variable)` adds the variable to a pending set
4. On the next `requestAnimationFrame`, all pending variables are processed
5. DOM elements with matching directives are updated

Multiple rapid changes in the same frame are batched into a single DOM update.

### Array Reactivity

**Observed methods:** `push`, `pop`, `splice`, `reverse`, `shift`, `sort`, `unshift`, `concat`, `update`, `updateWhere`, `removeWhere`

```js
// These trigger reactivity:
items.push({ id: 1, text: 'New' });
items.pop();
items.splice(0, 1);                              // remove first
items.splice(2, 1, { id: 3, text: 'Replaced' }); // replace at index
items.reverse();
items.shift();
items.unshift({ id: 0, text: 'First' });

// Convenience helpers (also trigger reactivity):
items.update(i, { done: true });                  // merge changes at index
items.updateWhere('id', 123, { done: true });     // find by property, merge changes
items.removeWhere('id', 123);                     // find by property, remove item

// This does NOT trigger reactivity:
items[0] = newItem;        // direct index assignment
items[0].text = 'Changed'; // nested property mutation
items.length = 0;          // length assignment
```

### Object Reactivity

Only properties defined in the `default` are observed. Adding new properties after init is not tracked.

```js
// Reactive (property defined in default):
config.theme = 'light';

// NOT reactive (new property):
config.newProp = 'value';
```

### Updating Nested Properties in Arrays

To update a property of an item inside an array, use the `update` helper or splice-replace:

```js
// WRONG — not reactive:
tasks[i].done = true;

// RIGHT — update helper (preferred):
tasks.update(i, { done: true });

// RIGHT — updateWhere (find by property, then update):
tasks.updateWhere('id', taskId, { done: true });

// RIGHT — removeWhere (find by property, then remove):
tasks.removeWhere('id', taskId);

// RIGHT — splice still works for full control:
tasks.splice(i, 1, Object.assign({}, tasks[i], { done: true }));
```

---

## Computed Values

```js
data: {
    price:    { type: Number, default: 10 },
    quantity: { type: Number, default: 1 },
    taxRate:  { type: Number, default: 7 },
    subtotal: { computed: 'price * quantity' },
    tax:      { computed: 'Math.round(price * quantity * taxRate) / 100' },
    total:    { computed: 'subtotal + tax' }
}
```

```html
<p>Subtotal: $<span s-bind="subtotal">{subtotal.toFixed(2)}</span></p>
<p>Total: $<span s-bind="total">{total.toFixed(2)}</span></p>
```

**Rules:**
- Computed values are read-only — assigning to them does nothing
- They re-evaluate every time a referenced variable changes
- Transitive: computed-of-computed works (e.g., `total` depends on `subtotal`)
- No `type` or `default` needed — just `computed`

### Filtered Lists (Computed Arrays)

```js
data: {
    tasks:  { type: Array, default: [...] },
    filter: { type: String, default: 'all' },
    query:  { type: String, default: '' },
    visibleTasks: {
        computed: "tasks.filter(function(t) { " +
            "var matchFilter = filter === 'all' || (filter === 'active' && !t.done) || (filter === 'done' && t.done); " +
            "var matchQuery = query.length === 0 || t.title.toLowerCase().indexOf(query.toLowerCase()) !== -1; " +
            "return matchFilter && matchQuery; " +
            "})"
    }
}
```

Use `function(){}` syntax (not arrow functions) in computed expressions for broadest compatibility.

```html
<!-- Iterate over the computed view, not the raw array -->
<div s-if="visibleTasks.length > 0">
    <div s-for="t of visibleTasks" s-key="t.id">
        <span s-text="t.title"></span>
    </div>
</div>
<div s-if="tasks.length === 0">No tasks yet.</div>
```

### Aggregation and Chaining

Computed values can aggregate arrays and chain off each other:

```js
data: {
    txs:            { type: Array, default: [] },
    budget:         { type: Number, default: 2000 },
    totalIncome:    { computed: "txs.reduce(function(s,t){ return t.type==='income' ? s+t.amount : s; }, 0)" },
    totalExpenses:  { computed: "txs.reduce(function(s,t){ return t.type==='expense' ? s+t.amount : s; }, 0)" },
    netBalance:     { computed: "totalIncome - totalExpenses" },
    budgetRemaining:{ computed: "budget - totalExpenses" },
    budgetPercent:  { computed: "budget > 0 ? Math.round(totalExpenses / budget * 100) : 0" }
}
```

All five derived values update automatically when `txs` changes.

### Reverse Display Order

Use `.slice().reverse()` to show newest items first without mutating the source array:

```js
visibleTxs: {
    computed: "txs.filter(function(t) { return true; }).slice().reverse()"
}
```

---

## Watchers

```js
data: {
    tasks: {
        type: Array,
        default: [],
        watch: function(newVal, oldVal) {
            var before = (oldVal || []).length;
            var after  = (newVal || []).length;
            if (after > before)      console.log('Task added');
            else if (after < before) console.log('Task removed');
            else                     console.log('Task updated');
        }
    }
}
```

**Rules:**
- `watch` receives `(newValue, oldValue)` as arguments
- Called after the UI has updated (during `processElements`)
- For arrays, `oldValue` is a shallow copy from before the mutation

---

## Persistence

### Store-Level Persistence

```js
let store = {
    persist: true,           // Enable for all variables (default)
    localPrefix: 'myapp_',   // Key prefix (default: '__')
    data: { ... }
};
```

### Per-Variable Override

```js
data: {
    preferences: { type: Object, default: {}, persist: true },  // always saved
    draft:       { type: String, default: '', persist: false },  // never saved
    name:        { type: String, default: '' }                   // follows store.persist
}
```

### Runtime Toggle

Both `store.persist` (global) and `store.data[variable].persist` (per-variable) can be changed at runtime:

```js
// Toggle all persistence off
store.persist = false;

// Toggle persistence for specific variables
store.data.tasks.persist = true;
store.data.tasks.persist = false;
```

### Complete Persistence Toggle Pattern

To let users toggle localStorage on/off with a switch that survives page reloads, store the
toggle state in its own localStorage key (outside the store prefix), since the toggle variable
itself cannot use the store's persistence mechanism:

```html
<label class="switch">
    <input type="checkbox" s-attr="checked: persist" onclick="togglePersist(this)">
    <span class="track"></span>
</label>
<span s-if="persist">Saved</span>
<span s-if="!persist">Not saved</span>
```

```js
// Store variable — default reads from its own localStorage key
data: {
    persist: { type: Boolean, default: localStorage.getItem('myapp_persist') !== '0', persist: false }
}
```

```js
// Fields whose persistence is toggled
var _fields = ['items', 'settings', 'preferences'];

function togglePersist(cb) {
    persist = cb.checked;
    localStorage.setItem('myapp_persist', persist ? '1' : '0');
    store.persist = persist;
    _fields.forEach(function(f) { store.data[f].persist = persist; });
    if (!persist) {
        var prefix = store.localPrefix;
        _fields.forEach(function(f) { localStorage.removeItem(prefix + f); });
    } else {
        // Save current state immediately
        var prefix = store.localPrefix;
        localStorage.setItem(prefix + 'items', JSON.stringify(items));
    }
}
```

```js
// Sync on init
onInit: function(data) {
    store.persist = persist;
    _fields.forEach(function(f) { store.data[f].persist = persist; });
}
```

### Clearing Persisted Data

```js
function clearPersistedData() {
    var prefix = store.localPrefix || '__';
    var toRemove = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
        var key = localStorage.key(i);
        if (key.indexOf(prefix) === 0) toRemove.push(key);
    }
    toRemove.forEach(function(k) { localStorage.removeItem(k); });
}
```

### Storage Format

- Strings stored as plain text (no JSON encoding)
- Objects and Arrays stored as `JSON.stringify(value)`
- Object properties stored as: `{prefix}{objectName}.{propertyName}`
- Scalars/Arrays stored as: `{prefix}{variableName}`

---

## Expression Sandbox

All directive expressions (`s-if`, `s-bind`, `s-click`, `s-class`, `s-css`, `s-attr`, `s-on`, `s-text`, `s-html`, computed values) are evaluated via `new Function()` in a sandboxed scope.

### Blocked Globals

`document`, `window`, `self`, `globalThis`, `fetch`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `Function`, `importScripts`, `setTimeout`, `setInterval`, `Proxy`, `Reflect`

### Blocked Patterns

`constructor`, `__proto__`, `getOwnPropertyDescriptor`, `defineProperty`, `getPrototypeOf`, `eval`, `prototype`

### Allowed Globals

`Math`, `parseInt`, `parseFloat`, `JSON`, `console`, `isNaN`, `isFinite`, `String`, `Number`, `Boolean`, `Array`, `Object`, `Date`, `RegExp`, `Map`, `Set`, `atob`, `btoa`, `encodeURI`, `decodeURI`, `encodeURIComponent`, `decodeURIComponent`

### Safe Expressions

```html
<!-- Arithmetic -->
<span s-bind="total">{price * quantity * 1.07}</span>

<!-- Ternary -->
<span s-if="count > 0">Has items</span>

<!-- String methods -->
<span s-text="name.toUpperCase()"></span>

<!-- Math -->
<span s-text="Math.round(score * 100) / 100"></span>

<!-- Array methods in computed -->
total: { computed: 'items.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.price, 0)' }
```

---

## Lifecycle

### Initialization Order

1. DOM ready (waits for `DOMContentLoaded` if needed)
2. `getData(store)` — reads persisted values from localStorage
3. Process `s-data` elements — auto-detect inline variables
4. Process `s-ref` elements — populate `$refs`
5. For each variable in `store.data`:
   - Create computed getter, OR
   - Create Observer/ArrayObserver
   - Set up window getter/setter
   - Load persisted value if available
6. Register `scheduleUpdate` observer on each variable
7. Initial `processElements()` for all variables (renders DOM)
8. Remove `s-cloak` attributes
9. Call `store.onInit(data)` if defined

### onInit

```js
onInit: function(data) {
    // data is the _data object with all reactive variables
    data.message = 'Initialized at ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString();

    // Can read URL params
    var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    if (params.get('user')) data.username = params.get('user');
}
```

---

## Common Patterns

### Task List with CRUD

```html
<input type="text" s-bind="draft" s-on="keydown.enter: addTask()" placeholder="New task">
<button s-click="addTask()" s-attr="disabled: draft.trim().length === 0">Add</button>

<div s-for="t of tasks" s-key="t.id">
    <input type="checkbox" s-attr="checked: t.done"
           s-click="tasks.updateWhere('id', t.id, {done: !t.done})">
    <span s-class="done: t.done" s-text="t.title"></span>
    <button s-click="tasks.removeWhere('id', t.id)">x</button>
</div>

<script>
let store = {
    data: {
        draft: { type: String, default: '' },
        tasks: { type: Array, default: [] }
    }
};

function addTask() {
    if (draft.trim() === '') return;
    tasks.push({ id: Date.now(), title: draft.trim(), done: false });
    draft = '';
}
</script>
```

### Filtered List with Search

```html
<input type="text" s-bind="query" s-debounce="200" placeholder="Search...">
<div class="pills">
    <button s-class="active: filter === 'all'"    s-click="filter = 'all'">All</button>
    <button s-class="active: filter === 'active'" s-click="filter = 'active'">Active</button>
    <button s-class="active: filter === 'done'"   s-click="filter = 'done'">Done</button>
</div>

<div s-for="t of visibleTasks" s-key="t.id">
    <span s-text="t.title"></span>
</div>

<p s-if="visibleTasks.length === 0">No results.</p>

<script>
let store = {
    data: {
        tasks:  { type: Array, default: [...] },
        filter: { type: String, default: 'all', persist: false },
        query:  { type: String, default: '', persist: false },
        visibleTasks: {
            computed: "tasks.filter(t => " +
                "(filter === 'all' || (filter === 'active' && !t.done) || (filter === 'done' && t.done)) && " +
                "(query.length === 0 || t.title.toLowerCase().indexOf(query.toLowerCase()) !== -1))"
        }
    }
};
</script>
```

### Dropdown / Click Outside

```html
<div style="position: relative;" s-unclick="open = false">
    <button s-click="open = !open">Menu</button>
    <div s-if="open" s-transition="fade" style="position: absolute; top: 100%;">
        <a href="#">Option 1</a>
        <a href="#">Option 2</a>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
let store = { data: { open: { type: Boolean, default: false, persist: false } } };
</script>
```

### Progress Bar

```html
<div style="height: 6px; background: #eee; border-radius: 3px;">
    <div s-css="width: {percent + '%'}" style="height: 100%; background: green; border-radius: 3px; transition: width 0.3s;"></div>
</div>
<span s-text="percent"></span>%

<script>
let store = {
    data: {
        tasks:     { type: Array, default: [...] },
        completed: { computed: 'tasks.filter(t => t.done).length' },
        percent:   { computed: 'tasks.length === 0 ? 0 : Math.round(completed / tasks.length * 100)' }
    }
};
</script>
```

### Form Validation

```html
<input type="text" s-bind="email" s-class="valid: emailOk; invalid: !emailOk && email.length > 0">
<button s-attr="disabled: !emailOk" s-click="submit()">Submit</button>

<script>
let store = {
    data: {
        email:   { type: String, default: '' },
        emailOk: { computed: "email.indexOf('@') > 0 && email.indexOf('.') > email.indexOf('@')" }
    }
};
</script>
```

### Counter (No Store)

```html
<div s-data="{count: 0}">
    <button s-click="count = Math.max(0, count - 1)">-</button>
    <span s-text="count"></span>
    <button s-click="count++">+</button>
</div>
```

### Dynamic Styling

```html
<input type="color" s-bind="accent">
<input type="range" min="14" max="48" s-bind="fontSize">

<div s-css="color: {accent}; font-size: {fontSize + 'px'}; border-color: {accent}">
    Preview text
</div>
```

---

## Common Mistakes

### 1. Direct index mutation (not reactive)

```js
// WRONG:
tasks[0].done = true;

// RIGHT (preferred):
tasks.update(0, { done: true });

// RIGHT (find by property):
tasks.updateWhere('id', taskId, { done: true });

// RIGHT (full control):
tasks.splice(0, 1, Object.assign({}, tasks[0], { done: true }));
```

### 2. Assigning to a computed value

```js
// WRONG: computed values are read-only
total = 100;

// RIGHT: change the source variables instead
price = 50;
quantity = 2;
// total recalculates automatically
```

### 3. Using onclick when s-click works inside s-for

```html
<!-- OLD PATTERN (no longer needed): -->
<div s-for="t of tasks" s-key="t.id">
    <button onclick="removeTask(this)">x</button>
</div>

<!-- BETTER: s-click works inside s-for with loop variable access -->
<div s-for="t of tasks" s-key="t.id">
    <button s-click="tasks.removeWhere('id', t.id)">x</button>
</div>
```

### 4. Missing s-key on s-for

```html
<!-- Works but inefficient for reordering: -->
<div s-for="item of items">{item.name}</div>

<!-- Better — enables keyed reconciliation: -->
<div s-for="item of items" s-key="item.id">{item.name}</div>
```

### 5. Using {template} syntax without s-bind on display elements

```html
<!-- WRONG: template won't update reactively -->
<p>Hello, {name}!</p>

<!-- RIGHT: needs s-bind to track updates -->
<p s-bind="name">Hello, {name}!</p>

<!-- ALSO RIGHT: s-text for plain text -->
<p s-text="'Hello, ' + name"></p>
```

### 6. Clearing an array by reassignment

```js
// WRONG: reassignment replaces the observed array with a plain one
items = [];

// RIGHT: splice to empty
items.splice(0, items.length);
```

### 7. Forgetting persist: false on ephemeral state

```js
// Clutters localStorage with temporary data:
data: {
    searchQuery: { type: String, default: '' }
}

// Better:
data: {
    searchQuery: { type: String, default: '', persist: false }
}
```

### 8. Using visibility: hidden for s-cloak

```css
/* WRONG: */
[s-cloak] { visibility: hidden; }

/* RIGHT: */
[s-cloak] { display: none !important; }
```

SensibleJS auto-injects the correct rule, but if you define your own, use `display: none !important`.

### 9. Adding new properties to observed objects

```js
// WRONG: new properties are not observed
config.newSetting = true;

// RIGHT: define all properties in the default
data: {
    config: { type: Object, default: { theme: 'dark', newSetting: false } }
}
```

### 10. Expecting s-for to work with non-Array types

```js
// WRONG: s-for only works with Arrays
data: { users: { type: Object, default: { alice: 1, bob: 2 } } }

// RIGHT: use Array of objects
data: { users: { type: Array, default: [{ name: 'alice', score: 1 }, { name: 'bob', score: 2 }] } }
```

### 11. Using arrow functions in computed expressions

```js
// May cause issues in some contexts — use function() instead:
visibleTasks: { computed: "tasks.filter(t => !t.done)" }

// SAFER:
visibleTasks: { computed: "tasks.filter(function(t) { return !t.done; })" }
```

### 12. Not syncing store.persist in onInit when using a persist toggle

```js
// WRONG: store.persist stays true even though user toggled it off
data: { persist: { type: Boolean, default: localStorage.getItem('x') !== '0', persist: false } }
// Missing onInit sync — store.persist is still true from the store definition

// RIGHT: sync on init
onInit: function(data) {
    store.persist = persist;
}
```

### 13. Building derived arrays without a watcher

When a computed value can't express the derivation (e.g., grouping, aggregation into a new array), use a watcher on the source array to rebuild a separate array:

```js
data: {
    txs: {
        type: Array, default: [],
        watch: function() { buildBreakdown(); }  // Rebuild on every change
    },
    categoryBreakdown: { type: Array, default: [], persist: false }
}
```

```js
function buildBreakdown() {
    var cats = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < txs.length; i++) {
        if (txs[i].type !== 'expense') continue;
        if (!cats[txs[i].category]) cats[txs[i].category] = 0;
        cats[txs[i].category] += txs[i].amount;
    }
    categoryBreakdown.splice(0, categoryBreakdown.length);
    Object.keys(cats).forEach(function(name) {
        categoryBreakdown.push({ id: name, name: name, total: cats[name] });
    });
}
```

---

## Complete Examples

### Example 1: Todo App

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <script src="sensibljs.min.js" defer></script>
    <style>
        [s-cloak] { display: none !important; }
        .done { text-decoration: line-through; color: #999; }
    </style>
</head>
<body s-cloak>
    <h1>Todos</h1>

    <input type="text" s-bind="draft" s-on="keydown.enter: addTodo()" placeholder="What needs doing?">
    <button s-click="addTodo()" s-attr="disabled: draft.trim().length === 0">Add</button>

    <p s-if="todos.length > 0">
        <span s-text="remaining"></span> remaining of <span s-text="todos.length"></span>
    </p>

    <div s-for="todo of todos" s-key="todo.id">
        <input type="checkbox" s-attr="checked: todo.done"
               s-click="todos.updateWhere('id', todo.id, {done: !todo.done})">
        <span s-class="done: todo.done" s-text="todo.title"></span>
        <button s-click="todos.removeWhere('id', todo.id)">x</button>
    </div>

    <p s-if="todos.length === 0">No todos yet.</p>

    <script>
    let store = {
        persist: true,
        data: {
            draft:     { type: String, default: '', persist: false },
            todos:     { type: Array, default: [] },
            remaining: { computed: 'todos.filter(t => !t.done).length' }
        }
    };

    function addTodo() {
        if (draft.trim() === '') return;
        todos.push({ id: Date.now(), title: draft.trim(), done: false });
        draft = '';
    }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

### Example 2: Dynamic Dashboard Card

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <script src="sensibljs.min.js" defer></script>
    <style>
        [s-cloak] { display: none !important; }
        .card { border: 2px solid #ccc; border-radius: 8px; padding: 20px; max-width: 400px; }
        .tag { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: #eee; margin: 2px; font-size: 0.85em; }
    </style>
</head>
<body s-cloak>
    <h2>Edit Card</h2>

    <label>Name</label>
    <input type="text" s-bind="cardName">

    <label>Role</label>
    <input type="text" s-bind="cardRole">

    <label>Accent Color</label>
    <input type="color" s-bind="cardAccent">

    <label>Show Email?</label>
    <input type="checkbox" s-bind="showEmail">

    <label>Add Skill</label>
    <input type="text" s-bind="newSkill" s-on="keydown.enter: addSkill()">
    <button s-click="addSkill()">Add</button>

    <div class="card" s-css="border-color: {cardAccent}">
        <h3 s-text="cardName"></h3>
        <p s-text="cardRole" s-css="color: {cardAccent}"></p>
        <p s-if="showEmail">Email: <span s-text="cardEmail"></span></p>
        <div>
            <span>Skills (<span s-text="skills.length"></span>):</span>
            <div s-for="skill of skills" s-key="skill.id">
                <span class="tag">
                    <span s-text="skill.name"></span>
                    <button s-click="skills.removeWhere('id', skill.id)" style="border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;">x</button>
                </span>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
    let store = {
        data: {
            cardName:  { type: String, default: 'Jane Developer' },
            cardRole:  { type: String, default: 'Frontend Engineer' },
            cardAccent:{ type: String, default: '#6366f1' },
            cardEmail: { type: String, default: 'jane@example.com' },
            showEmail: { type: Boolean, default: true },
            skills:    { type: Array, default: [
                { id: 1, name: 'JavaScript' },
                { id: 2, name: 'CSS' },
                { id: 3, name: 'HTML' }
            ]},
            newSkill:  { type: String, default: '', persist: false }
        }
    };

    function addSkill() {
        if (newSkill.trim() === '') return;
        skills.push({ id: Date.now(), name: newSkill.trim() });
        newSkill = '';
    }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```
